title: Evolution Of Police 1791
definition: The formal reorganization of the police system in Bengal in 1791 under Lord Cornwallis, which established a regular district police force headed by a Daroga, replacing the traditional feudal Zamindari police system.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial microtopic under Modern Indian History (Evolution of Administrative and Police Services). It highlights British colonial state-building, centralization of executive authority, and the structural shift from indigenous decentralized policing to a bureaucratic colonial security apparatus.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Evolution Of Police 1791.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core administrative policies of Lord Cornwallis
Separation of powers under the Cornwallis Code
